contract.current: Exact membership in complete offered menu; absent descriptors are INELIGIBLE only at t0. This is not hidden-predicate reconstruction.
contract.future: UNKNOWN actual existence/survival/terminal/service/movement. Conditional reference geometry and ledger never guarantee future execution.

service: rendered glyph case / visibleMap.inService = available && health>0
hostility: canonicalState.entities.hostile = kind hostility OR hostile faction
protected: positive PROTECT implies unprotected at t0; ledger PROTECT makes protected exact
planned: positive BUILD implies planned && !available at t0
acceptsMaterial: positive TRANSFER implies acceptsMaterial at t0
availability: service=false does not identify available=false versus health=0
health: individual nonactor health omitted; aggregate features do not identify per-entity health
relationSubtype: substitutes/supplies/protects all map to supports before packet delivery

rules.TRANSFER: No energy eligibility gate in frozen legalActions; declared cost still subtracted.
rules.COLLECT: Requires available RESOURCE co-location, not health>0.
rules.RESTORE: Requires !available and non-HOSTILE kind; service=false alone insufficient.
rules.ATTACK: Requires HOSTILE kind and health>0, not available=true.
rules.BYPASS: Requires dependsOn edge, failed !available, live typed substitute; lexical lowest eligible substitute.
